Scholarship overview

This Oxford studentship works at the intersection of synthetic biology, control engineering, AI and robotics. Depending on the research direction, work may involve engineering microbes, developing computational design methods or building platforms for automated measurement and control.

Research Areas

  • Synthetic biology
  • Control systems
  • Robotics

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryAt least GBP 21,805/year first-year reference rate
Duration3.5 years
TuitionHome-rate funding; international support requires confirmation

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationFirst-class or strong 2:1 degree in a relevant engineering, science, computing or mathematics subject.
Further conditionsHome fees funded; international applicants should confirm fee support before applying.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round2 December 2026, noon UK time
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Oxford

Oxford offers doctoral research through its departments and colleges. The DPhil is its doctoral qualification, and funded research projects have their own supervision, academic selection and application requirements.
